scope: Research-methodology remediation audit; explicitly distinguish changed, partial, unchanged and unverified study requirements
controls: Tiny temporary missing-input/zero-epoch benchmark and two-label completeness controls; extracted filename-discovery control; no trained model or clinical evaluation
invalid_benchmark_output_warning: All AUC/F1/accuracy/significance values in claims control outputs are emitted hardcoded fixtures, NOT measured empirical performance. They must not be used in study results.
new_geometry_defect: Native hard-mask export with inference-grid affine-less probabilities; ensemble still uses hard-mask affine for probability resampling. Static dataflow finding, no production inference rerun.
reference_metric_defect: Flat JHU discovery can pair CT as own label in optional radiologist metric path; historical use not established
evidence_limit: No local result/log files. No claim is made that separate remote or unpublished studies do not exist. Source additions and comments alone do not demonstrate executed methodological fixes.
